title: Do you think I’m crazy to protect my fruit trees this way? 🤔🌳 Would y...
description: Do you think I’m crazy to protect my fruit trees this way? 🤔🌳 Would you do this to ensure fruit on your trees? 🍎🍑 Over the years, I’ve tried everything to protect my fruit trees from those sneaky late-season freezes! ❄️ Here’s what I’ve tested so far: 🛏️ Blankets & Covers – Classic, but not always enough. 💦 Sprinkler System – The ice coating can protect, but too many branches snapped. 🔥 Fires Below the Trees – Worked great! But this year, there’s a fire watch, so that’s off the table. 🚀 This year’s plan? Commercial fans to keep the air moving and push the cold out! 🍃 This is a trick commercial orchards use, and I’m giving it a shot. 🤞 Would you try this? Or do you have a go-to freeze protection method? Drop your thoughts below! ⬇️ #fruitgrowing #frostprotection #fruittrees #gardeninghacks #orchardlife #coldweathergardening #homeorchard #gardeningtips #backyardgardener #sustainablegrowing #growyourfood
